verdict.score_rationale: The board lands between composed and finished: it fills the frame with intentional sections, meaningful flow colors, and strong registers, but a broad central gap and an ambiguous multi-wire convergence near publication keep it below the 8 anchor.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The upper workflow and two lower operational panels use the wide frame deliberately, though the large horizontal band between them is visibly underoccupied.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Gray supports the primary topology while red/orange marks failure and mismatch paths, purple identifies rebuild flow, and yellow is reserved for policy notes; semantics are consistent.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair waypoints or floating badges are visible, but the converging store wires at the right side of the publication-consistency diamond form an ambiguous junction.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The five-column upper sequence, aligned second row, and paired lower panels establish strong registers and deliberate density, with only some stretched connector runs weakening the rhythm.
